title: Implement idempotent handoff and turn-triggered recovery
description:
Close the crash windows between durable state and queue delivery.

Acceptance criteria:
- Appending work and requesting its logical enqueue can be retried idempotently.
- Active workers renew both their turn claim and SQS visibility.
- Each started turn schedules its own deadline or watchdog; there is no idle polling process.
- Recovery creates at most one next attempt or a visible terminal state.
- Ambiguous provider outcomes have an explicit reconciliation state.

comments.text: 19eddc is closed on main. This task is the next recovery slice: idempotent enqueue, SQS visibility renewal, turn-triggered deadline, reconciling ambiguous provider outcomes. No always-on reaper.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Review (Composer 2.5): WIP in /tmp/chatticus-e42008 — behave+pytest pass with PYTHONPATH but branch unpushed. Blockers before AWS: (1) InMemoryTurnDeadlineScheduler only — no Lambda/EventBridge watchdog; recovery_enabled not wired in plane_from_env. (2) POST /turns/{id}/deadline is a manual test hook — do not ship to front door. (3) runtime SQS dedup is per-invocation memory only. (4) ComputerlessWorker never calls /renew despite new API. Gherkin green in isolation.
